description: Eaton Corp. Plc is a power management company, which provides energy-efficient solutions for electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. It operates through the following segments: Electrical Americas and Electrical Global; Aerospace, Vehicle, and eMobility. The Electrical…
transcript_take: Q1 2026 was a record: adjusted EPS $2.81 ($0.06 above the guide midpoint), record revenue $7.5B on 10% organic growth (~12% ex-Mobility), segment profit a Q1 record $1.7B at 22.7% margin, and free cash flow +245% YoY, with Electrical Americas LTM orders +42% and data-center orders +240%. Eaton RAISED FY2026 organic-growth guidance 200 bps to 9-11% and EPS to $13.05-$13.50. But Electrical Americas margin of 25.6% MISSED on price-cost lag and accelerated multi-facility ramp costs, forcing a 50-bp CUT to FY2026 segment-margin guidance (to 24.1-24.5%) at the very point of the thesis — a genuine mixed print (top-line/orders/EPS raise vs a margin-line cut); new CFO Dave Foster replaced Olivier Leonetti (departed Apr 1, 2026).
mda_take: The FY2025 10-K reports net sales of $27.4B (up from $24.9B in 2024) with strategy centered on datacenter/AI, electrification and infrastructure; Eaton closed Fibrebond and Resilient Power in 2025, agreed to acquire Boyd Thermal (data-center liquid cooling), closed Ultra PCS (Jan 23, 2026), and on Jan 26, 2026 announced intent to spin off the Mobility (Vehicle + eMobility) segment by end of Q1 2027. Capital return continued under a new $9.0B three-year buyback (~$7.6B remaining at year-end).
